title: Nf Primality Proof Resume
objective: Complete deterministic resumable arbitrary-size primality proofs and branch-local split state

handoff.summary: Added deterministic resumable Pocklington proof checkpoints, exact resource receipts, fair probable-branch splitting, fail-closed independent validators, and branch-local decomposition replacement APIs. Exact PARI vectors 168, 250, 285, 314, and 365 are certified in CPython and Sage.js.
risks: Completion requires callers to resume with positive work budgets and a recursion-depth limit large enough for the input; exhaustion is explicitly non-proof evidence.
Broad test:changed reaches unrelated inherited local_polygons boundary and missing optional FLINT/native-cache failures; focused pure-Python checks pass.
next_steps: Integrate the exported proof and branch-local certification helpers into the public maximal-order engine.
Rerun the five-case corpus sweep with the proof completion budget.
